WITH BaseRouters AS (
  SELECT 
    node_id, 
    long_name, 
    CAST(node_id AS bigint) % 256 AS node_byte,
    -- Step 1: Create the aliases
    COALESCE(substring(last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), 'Unknown') AS channel,
    COALESCE(TRIM(REPLACE(substring(last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')), 'Unknown') AS region
  FROM node_details
  WHERE role IN ('ROUTER', 'ROUTER_LATE') AND node_id ~ '^[0-9]+$'
),
RouterNodes AS (
  -- Step 2: Apply the Grafana filters to the newly created aliases
  SELECT * FROM BaseRouters
  WHERE region IN ($Region)
    AND channel IN ($Channel)
),
TrafficStats AS (
  -- Step 3: Proceed with the traffic math using the filtered list
  SELECT
    r.long_name AS router_name,
    r.channel,
    r.region,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.source_id = r.node_id THEN 1 END) AS self_tx_total,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.source_id = r.node_id AND m.portnum = 'TELEMETRY_APP' THEN 1 END) AS telemetry_tx,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.source_id = r.node_id AND m.portnum = 'POSITION_APP' THEN 1 END) AS position_tx,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.source_id = r.node_id AND m.portnum = 'NODEINFO_APP' THEN 1 END) AS nodeinfo_tx,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.source_id = r.node_id AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' THEN 1 END) AS traceroute_tx,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.relay_node = r.node_byte OR m.next_hop = r.node_byte THEN 1 END) AS relayed_total
  FROM RouterNodes r
  LEFT JOIN mesh_packet_metrics m
    ON (m.source_id = r.node_id OR m.relay_node = r.node_byte OR m.next_hop = r.node_byte)
    AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY r.long_name, r.channel, r.region
),
ScoredRouters AS (
  SELECT
    router_name,
    channel,
    region,
    self_tx_total,
    relayed_total,
    telemetry_tx,
    position_tx,
    nodeinfo_tx,
    traceroute_tx,
    (self_tx_total + relayed_total) AS total_throughput,
    -- Relays (+5), Traceroutes (+2), Noise (-1)
    (relayed_total * 5) + (traceroute_tx * 2) - (telemetry_tx * 1) - (position_tx * 1) AS router_score
  FROM TrafficStats
)

SELECT
  router_name AS "Router",
  router_score AS "Score",
  region AS "Region",
  channel AS "Channel",
  relayed_total AS "Relayed (Jobs Done)",
  self_tx_total AS "Self Tx (Noise)",
  CASE 
    WHEN (self_tx_total + relayed_total) = 0 THEN '❌ Offline'
    WHEN router_score < 0 AND relayed_total = 0 THEN '🚨 Demote (Pure Noise)'
    WHEN router_score < 0 AND relayed_total > 0 THEN '⚠️ Noisy'
    WHEN router_score >= 0 AND router_score < 50 THEN '🥉 Marginal'
    WHEN router_score >= 50 AND router_score < 200 THEN '🥈 Good'
    ELSE '🥇 Excellent'
  END AS "Assessment"

FROM ScoredRouters
ORDER BY "Score" DESC;

WITH OfflineRouters AS (
  -- STEP 1: Identify routers that are CURRENTLY silent (using the Wide Net logic)
  SELECT 
    n.node_id,
    -- Custom label logic: Hide the second line if both metadata points are missing
    CASE 
      WHEN substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$') IS NULL 
       AND substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/') IS NULL
      THEN COALESCE(n.long_name, n.node_id)
      ELSE 
        COALESCE(n.long_name, n.node_id) || E'\n' || 
        COALESCE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), 'Unknown') || ' | ' || 
        COALESCE(TRIM(REPLACE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')), 'Unknown')
    END AS card_label
  FROM node_details n
  LEFT JOIN (
      -- Heartbeat check: Relays, Gateways, and Telemetry count as "Active"
      SELECT source_id::text AS node_id, "time" FROM mesh_packet_metrics
      UNION ALL
      SELECT relay_node::text AS node_id, "time" FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE relay_node IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT reporting_gateway::text AS node_id, "time" FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT node_id::text, "time" FROM device_metrics
      UNION ALL
      SELECT node_id::text, "time" FROM position_metrics
      UNION ALL
      SELECT node_id::text, device_time AS "time" FROM node_telemetry WHERE device_time IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT node_id::text, environment_time AS "time" FROM node_telemetry WHERE environment_time IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT node_id::text, power_time AS "time" FROM node_telemetry WHERE power_time IS NOT NULL
  ) m ON n.node_id::text = m.node_id
  WHERE n.role IN ('ROUTER', 'ROUTER_LATE')
  GROUP BY n.node_id, n.long_name, n.last_heard_topic
  HAVING MAX(m.time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' OR MAX(m.time) IS NULL
),
TimeGrid AS (
  -- STEP 2: Generate a continuous daily calendar
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('day', to_timestamp($__from / 1000)),
    date_trunc('day', to_timestamp($__to / 1000)),
    '1 day'::interval
  ) AS day_bucket
),
RouterGrid AS (
  -- STEP 3: Create a slot for every offline router on every day
  SELECT t.day_bucket, o.node_id, o.card_label
  FROM TimeGrid t
  CROSS JOIN OfflineRouters o
)

-- STEP 4: Final output with raw_id included
SELECT 
  r.day_bucket AS "time",
  r.card_label AS "metric",
  r.node_id AS "raw_id",
  COUNT(m.packet_id) AS "value"
FROM RouterGrid r
LEFT JOIN mesh_packet_metrics m 
  ON r.node_id::text = m.source_id::text 
  AND date_trunc('day', m.time) = r.day_bucket
  AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

WITH FilteredRouters AS (
  -- Pre-flight check: Find routers with active battery movement
  -- Excludes permanently plugged-in/pegged nodes (>=100%) and dead/sensorless nodes (0%)
  SELECT d.node_id
  FROM device_metrics d
  JOIN node_details n ON d.node_id = n.node_id
  WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND n.role IN ('ROUTER', 'REPEATER', 'BASE', 'ROUTER_LATE')
    AND d.battery_level IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.node_id
  HAVING MIN(d.battery_level) < 100 
     AND MAX(d.battery_level) > 0
)
-- Main Graph Query
SELECT
  d.time AS "time",
  COALESCE(n.long_name, d.node_id) AS "metric",
  d.battery_level AS "battery"
FROM device_metrics d
JOIN node_details n ON d.node_id = n.node_id
-- This JOIN acts as our strict filter, blocking any node not on the approved list
JOIN FilteredRouters fr ON d.node_id = fr.node_id
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(d.time)
ORDER BY
  d.time ASC;

WITH TargetRouters AS (
  SELECT
    REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS clean_id,
    MAX(long_name) AS long_name,
    MAX(role) AS role
  FROM node_details
  WHERE role IN ('ROUTER', 'ROUTER_LATE')
  GROUP BY 1
),
ActiveNodes AS (
  SELECT
    REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS node_id,
    MAX(time) AS last_any_packet
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY 1
),
AbsoluteLastNeighborInfo AS (
  SELECT
    REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS node_id,
    MAX(time) AS last_tx
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE portnum = 'NEIGHBORINFO_APP'
  GROUP BY 1
),
DashboardIntervals AS (
  SELECT
    REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS node_id,
    CASE 
      -- 🚫 THE MULTIPATH FIX: Count distinct minutes instead of raw rows!
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('minute', time)) > 1 
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(time) - MIN(time))) / (COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('minute', time)) - 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS avg_interval_sec
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE portnum = 'NEIGHBORINFO_APP'
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(tr.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || tr.clean_id || ')') AS "Router Node",
  tr.role AS "Role",
  
  -- When the node was last seen alive
  CASE
    WHEN (NOW() - an.last_any_packet) < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN 'Just now'
    WHEN (NOW() - an.last_any_packet) < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - an.last_any_packet))::int || 'm ago'
    WHEN (NOW() - an.last_any_packet) < INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (NOW() - an.last_any_packet))::int || 'h ago'
    ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - an.last_any_packet))::int || 'd ago'
  END AS "Last Heard (Alive)",

  -- When it last sent a NeighborInfo packet (Absolute Truth)
  CASE
    WHEN alni.last_tx IS NULL THEN '🔴 Never'
    WHEN (NOW() - alni.last_tx) < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN 'Just now'
    WHEN (NOW() - alni.last_tx) < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - alni.last_tx))::int || 'm ago'
    WHEN (NOW() - alni.last_tx) < INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (NOW() - alni.last_tx))::int || 'h ago'
    ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - alni.last_tx))::int || 'd ago'
  END AS "Last NeighborInfo",

  -- The Emoji-Labeled Interval Logic
  CASE
    WHEN di.avg_interval_sec IS NULL THEN '⚪ Not Enough Data'
    ELSE 
      CASE 
        WHEN di.avg_interval_sec < 36000 THEN '🟡 '         -- Under 10 hours
        WHEN di.avg_interval_sec <= 43200 THEN '🟢 '        -- 10 to 12 hours
        ELSE '🔴 '                                          -- Over 12 hours
      END
      ||
      CASE
        WHEN di.avg_interval_sec < 3600 THEN ROUND((di.avg_interval_sec / 60)::numeric, 1) || ' mins'
        ELSE ROUND((di.avg_interval_sec / 3600)::numeric, 1) || ' hours'
      END
  END AS "Detected Interval"

FROM TargetRouters tr
INNER JOIN ActiveNodes an ON tr.clean_id = an.node_id
LEFT JOIN AbsoluteLastNeighborInfo alni ON tr.clean_id = alni.node_id
LEFT JOIN DashboardIntervals di ON tr.clean_id = di.node_id

ORDER BY 
  alni.last_tx ASC NULLS FIRST, 
  an.last_any_packet DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH RecentActivity AS (
  -- Find nodes that have spoken AT ALL in the last 48 hours
  SELECT source_id, MAX(time) AS last_heard
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
  GROUP BY source_id
),
PositionHistory AS (
  -- Find the absolute latest position packet for everyone
  SELECT source_id, MAX(time) AS last_position
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE portnum = 'POSITION_APP'
  GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT
  n.node_id AS "Node ID",
  n.long_name AS "Node Name",
  n.role AS "Role",
  p.last_position AS "Last Position Time",
  a.last_heard AS "Last Heard (Any Packet)"
FROM node_details n
-- INNER JOIN forces the query to ONLY include nodes found in the RecentActivity list
JOIN RecentActivity a 
  ON n.node_id = a.source_id
LEFT JOIN PositionHistory p 
  ON n.node_id = p.source_id
WHERE 
  n.role IN ('ROUTER', 'ROUTER_LATE')
  -- Filter for nodes with stale or missing position data
  AND (p.last_position < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' OR p.last_position IS NULL)
ORDER BY 
  "Last Position Time" DESC;

WITH Yesterday AS (
  SELECT source_id, AVG(rx_snr) as avg_snr_yesterday
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' AND time < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY source_id
),
Today AS (
  SELECT source_id, AVG(rx_snr) as avg_snr_today
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT
  n.node_id AS "Node ID",
  n.long_name AS "Node Name",
  ROUND(y.avg_snr_yesterday::numeric, 2) AS "Avg SNR (Yesterday)",
  ROUND(t.avg_snr_today::numeric, 2) AS "Avg SNR (Today)",
  ROUND((t.avg_snr_today - y.avg_snr_yesterday)::numeric, 2) AS "Net Change"
FROM node_details n
JOIN Yesterday y ON n.node_id = y.source_id
JOIN Today t ON n.node_id = t.source_id
WHERE 
  n.role IN ('ROUTER', 'ROUTER_LATE')
  -- Only show nodes where the signal got worse by 2.0 or more
  AND (t.avg_snr_today - y.avg_snr_yesterday) <= -2.0
ORDER BY "Net Change" ASC;

SELECT 
  REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS "Router ID",
  COALESCE(MAX(n.long_name), REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '')) AS "Router Name",
  COUNT(m.packet_id) AS "Total Leaked Packets",
  -- 📍 Lists every gateway that uploaded this router's private packets
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(gn.long_name, REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')), ', ') AS "Complicit Gateways"
FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
-- Join to get the hardware role of the sender
LEFT JOIN node_details n ON REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')
-- Join to get the friendly name of the gateway that uploaded it
LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
  AND n.role IN ('ROUTER', 'ROUTER_LATE')
  
  -- 📍 The Smoking Gun: The packet explicitly requested to stay strictly on RF...
  AND m.ok_to_mqtt = FALSE 
  
  -- 📍 ...but a gateway bridged it to the internet anyway!
  AND m.reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC;
